description: Patterns that are right, from a review: names from content, images, labels, internals and generated text; a heading, a region that scrolls, a region with drag to scroll (a press listener only), a region with a canvas that animates by itself, a skip target; a custom element whose closed shadow root holds a button. None is a control without a role; nothing animated is taken for an effect. The only finding is the disabled button without a name.
